newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Eurotherm up on "buy" note.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eurotherm up on "buy" note.

text.p: Shares in British industrial and scientific equipment maker Eurotherm Plc gained almost five percent on Friday after ABN Amro Hoare Govett issued a "buy" note on the stock.
Eurotherm was up 25-1/2p at 597-1/2p with 475,000 stocks traded by 0754 GMT. The broader market was up 0.3 percent.
ABN Amro Hoare Govett analyst Robert Harris said he raised his recommendation from "undervalued" on Friday morning.
"We feel the stock is 30 percent too cheap at current levels and a string of new products in the next 12 months should drive the profit line amid significant cash generation," Harris said.

Harris said he was targeting a share price of 740p in the next 12 months, with Eurotherm's management geared more to creating shareholder value amid a drive to boost efficiency and quality in its drives, controls and recorders businesses.
